title.narrative: NPA Victim-Centred Prosecutions in the NPA

description.narrative: Overall, the project will contribute to the knowledge and capacity development of the South African National Prosecuting Agency. The project activities will set the foundation for its future actions in order to achieve the results set out in their Medium Term Strategic Framework and Annual Performance Plans. More specifically, the project will support the NPA have a better understanding of the services needed by victims of crime and will have an increased understanding of how to effect structural, operational and behavioural change within the organisation.

There were 2 main outputs from the project 'Strengthening Victim-Centred Prosecutions in the National Prosecuting Authority':
Output 1: Victim-centred prosecutions - The report developed by the project will be used by the National Prosecuting Authority (NPA) in efforts to strengthen victim-centred prosecutions. - The report has been reviewed by the Management Task team of the NPA established and will be discussed at the NPA Strategic Planning Sessions. - At the NPA Strategic Planning Session, plans will be made to action the suggestions from the report and will be reflected in the NPA Annual Performance Plan.
Output 2: Change Management - The report developed by the project, along with guidelines, will be available for use at NPA. - It is anticipated that the NPA staff will need further guidance and training which the Institute for Security Studies will be able to provide - assisted by the project report.
